newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KLI surges to year-high, baffles players.
newsitem.headline: KLI surges to year-high, baffles players.

text.p: Kuala Lumpur Industries Holdings Bhd (KLI) surged to a 12-month high at midday on Tuesday, with traders and analysts generally baffled by the rise.
Officials at the property and consumer products firm were not immediately available for comment.

Some traders cited rumours of a share placement, a share swap with another firm and a possible infrastructure contract as being reasons for the jump. A source close to the company suggested that the launch of competitively priced electrical appliances by a subsidiary could be a reason.
